page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-48-lssd is a compute-focused instance featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 504 MB L3 cache and 180 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This configuration integrates 2951 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 local drives. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations, alongside hardware-assisted cryptography and virtualization.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong performance characteristics across diverse workloads. Single-core processing is highly efficient, with Geekbench single-core and image processing scores reaching top-tier classifications. Multi-threaded performance is also robust, as evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 70646.91 and strong software compilation and ray tracing metrics. Memory subsystem performance is highlighted by a cached read-only small block bandwidth of 3861.88 GB/sec. For data processing, the instance achieves top-tier single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression speeds. In database and key-value store simulations, it delivers 89.08 million Redis SET operations per second and strong Passmark database throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-standard-48-lssd offers a high-density resource profile by bundling substantial local NVMe storage directly with dedicated compute cores, reducing the need for external block storage attachments for high-I/O tasks. The inclusion of AMX instructions enables efficient local LLM inference, processing 135M parameter models at top-tier text generation speeds and 7B parameter models at strong rates without requiring dedicated GPU hardware. This server type is highly suited for high-performance database hosting, software compilation pipelines, real-time data compression, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
